DeterminationBasis: T16-001 directly governs the claim ceiling by requiring a material claim to remain bounded to established evidence and evaluated scope. Its failure oracle rejects a claim that materially exceeds what the evidence establishes. This directly satisfies CONF-021's requirement that the conformance determination preserve its claim ceiling.

T16-003 rejects unsupported inflation to independently verified or other stronger external status, and T16-006 governs prerequisites when independent verification is positively claimed. Neither existing control requires a self-assessed PASS to positively identify itself as self-assessed where otherwise it could reasonably be understood as independent verification. WORD-001 therefore requires a distinct self-assessment labelling control.
